note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or passage (Num 9:15-23 and Job 23:3-9 in full), the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' as Meyer drops words. Meyer's bracketed gloss on Prov 3:6 '(or make plain)' stands outside the quotation marks. 'Be filled with the Spirit' (Eph 5:18), the last chapter's theme, is OWB's «መንፈስ ይሙላችሁ» in its heading and body alike; 'I am with you alway' is OWB's Matt 28:20 everywhere it recurs. OWB numbers 'I have been crucified with Christ' as Gal 2:19. A mis-cited 'Luke 4:26' (for 14:26) was corrected.

`self_rendered` rows carry a `why`: allusions, bare citations, Meyer's prayers built on a verse, re-personed lines (Ps 31:20 'hide me'), his blend 'Lord, save, or I perish', and one founder call: Heb 11:11, where OWB makes Abraham the subject of 'received power' and Meyer argues from Sarah.
